name: Our Summer Crush
source:
Your sister invites her best friend on your summer getaway... the best friend you've always liked a little too much.

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Our_Summer_Crush]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
你們姊妹倆出門過暑假，她還邀請了自己最好的朋友同行……偏偏你對這位朋友的喜歡，一直都多了那麼一點。

［取自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Our_Summer_Crush]Choices Wikia[/url]］
